propositions: The binding store's reverse map contains 13 orphaned keys (REB-410…REB-422) pointing to deleted local tickets with no corresponding forward bindings, causing fsck to report store_integrity=13.

All 13 orphaned entries reference deleted ZZ-*TEST fixture scaffolding created under a different environment (env_id ade0f2ef-…), not the current store (01a1a015-…), making them benign test data unrelated to live tickets.

The BindingStore.unbind() function cannot clean up these orphans because it only pops reverse keys when the forward entry still carries a jira_key, but the missing forward entry is precisely the fault, leaking the keys permanently.

The operator decided to delete (not tombstone) the 13 orphaned reverse entries directly via BindingStore.delete() and commit_and_push_tickets_branch(), delivering one pure 13-line deletion to .bridge_state/bindings.json with no code changes.
After repair execution, rebar bridge fsck reports store_integrity=0 with bindings=2111, reverse=2111 (down from 2124), and all alerting binding_drift cells remain empty as expected.

The repair was completed through rebar's supported library surface with no ad-hoc raw git in the tracker; the deletion survives on origin/tickets and the forward map and bindings-retired.json remain byte-identical.
